# `status` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "status" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/status/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique status id (a spell’s status op names it). |
| `name` | string | required | Player-facing name. |
| `description` | string | required | Player-facing one-line description. |
| `stack` | object | required | What reapplying the status does. |
| `stack.rule` | `"refresh"` \| `"stack"` \| `"keep"` | required | refresh, stack or keep. |
| `stack.max` | integer 2–99 | — | Most stacks; required for (and only for) rule "stack". |
| `tags` | list of id | `[]` | Dispel tags: "magical", "curse", "mundane"… |
| `modifiers` | list of object | `[]` | Stat modifiers while the status lasts. |
| `modifiers[].stat` | `"moveSpeed"` \| `"castSpeed"` \| `"gravityScale"` \| `"damageDealt"` \| `"damageTaken"` \| `"visibility"` | required | Stat changed. |
| `modifiers[].mode` | `"add"` \| `"multiply"` | required | Added, or multiplied, per stack. |
| `modifiers[].value` | number | required | Amount per stack (multiply: 0.5 halves it, 0 stops it). |
| `tick` | object | — | Ops applied to the target every `interval` seconds while the status lasts. |
| `tick.interval` | number > 0 ≤ 60 | required | Seconds between ticks. |
| `tick.ops` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Damage dealt to the target each tick (instigator: the status source). |
| `tick.ops[].amounts` | map of `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"shock"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"poison"` → number ≥ 0 | required | Damage points per damage type (before resistances); unlisted types deal 0. |
| `tick.ops[].poiseDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Poise damage in points. |
| `tick.ops[].staminaDamage` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Stamina drained from a blocker, in points (before shield stability). |
| `tick.ops[].impulse` | object | `{"x":0,"y":0,"z":0}` | Knockback impulse, N·s, in the attacker’s frame (+z forward, +y up). |
| `tick.ops[].impulse.x` | number | required |  |
| `tick.ops[].impulse.y` | number | required |  |
| `tick.ops[].impulse.z` | number | required |  |
| `tick.ops[].impactForce` | number ≥ 0 | `0` | Peak impact force, N (breakables, knockdown). |
| `tick.ops[].tags` | list of id | `[]` | Damage-packet tags every hit carries, e.g. "critical" (damage model tags). |
| `tick.ops[].op` | `"damage"` | required |  |
| `sourceBound` | boolean | `false` | Ends in the tick its source entity is destroyed (vines, a tether, an aura). |
| `breakWhen` | list of object | `[]` | Property tests that end the status early; any one holding ends it. |
| `breakWhen[].entity` | `"source"` \| `"target"` | required | Whose property is tested. |
| `breakWhen[].property` | string | required | World property read from that entity (e.g. "burning"). |
| `breakWhen[].is` | `"eq"` \| `"ne"` \| `"gte"` \| `"lte"` | required | How it is compared: eq, ne, gte or lte. |
| `breakWhen[].value` | boolean or number or string | required | Value compared against; the status ends when the test holds. |
